Privacy policy

Last updated: November 4, 2026

This policy explains what personal information SideQuest (“SideQuest”, “we”, “us”) collects when you use the SideQuest website and app, why, and the choices you have. SideQuest is operated from Ontario, Canada, and handles personal information in line with Canada’s Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA).

Questions or requests: support@your-domain.com.

What we collect

  • Account information: your email address and a salted hash of your password. We never store your password itself.
  • Your workspace: the projects, ideas, steps, notes, blockers, income figures and progress you enter, and your current focus session.
  • Billing information: if you subscribe to Pro, our payment processor Stripe collects your payment details. We receive and store only your Stripe customer and subscription IDs, your plan, its status and renewal date. We never see or store your card number.
  • Technical information: server logs containing IP addresses, request times and pages requested, and a record of recent sign-in and password-reset attempts used to block abuse.

We don’t knowingly collect information from anyone under 16.

How we use it

  • To provide SideQuest: store your workspace, sign you in, and show your progress.
  • To process payments and manage your subscription.
  • To send account emails you need, such as password resets and billing notices.
  • To keep the service secure, prevent abuse, and fix problems.

We don’t sell or rent your personal information, show ads, or use third-party analytics or tracking scripts. Your workspace content isn’t used to train AI models. We only use your information for these purposes, or as required by law.

Consent

By creating an account you consent to the collection and use of your information as described here. You can withdraw consent at any time by deleting your account; we then can no longer provide the service to you.

Who we share it with

We share personal information only with service providers who help us run SideQuest, and only as much as they need:

  • Hosting: Render, which runs our servers and stores the database.
  • Payments: Stripe, for subscriptions and billing.
  • Email delivery: our transactional email provider, for password-reset and account emails.

These providers may store or process information outside Canada, including in the United States, where it may be accessible to authorities under local law. We may also disclose information if required by law, or to protect the rights and safety of our users or SideQuest.

Cookies

We use one essential cookie to keep you signed in. It lasts up to 30 days or until you log out. There are no advertising or analytics cookies.

How long we keep it

  • Your account and workspace: until you delete your account.
  • Server logs and sign-in attempt records: up to 30 days.
  • Database backups: up to 30 days, after which deleted data is gone from them too.
  • Billing records: Stripe and we keep transaction records as long as tax law requires (in Canada, generally six years).

Security

Connections to SideQuest are encrypted with HTTPS. Passwords are stored as salted hashes, sign-in attempts are rate-limited, and each account’s workspace is kept separate from every other account. No system is perfectly secure; if a breach creates a real risk of significant harm to you, we will notify you and the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada as the law requires.

Your rights

  • Access and export: download a complete copy of your workspace from the app at any time, or ask us for the personal information we hold about you.
  • Correction: edit your workspace in the app, or ask us to correct your account information.
  • Deletion: use Delete account in the app footer. This immediately removes your account and workspace and cancels any subscription.

We’ll respond to requests within 30 days. If you’re not satisfied with our answer, you can contact the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada.

Changes

If we make material changes to this policy, we’ll email you before they take effect and update the date above.
